exercises.why: **переходил** — переходи́ть (imperfective): to cross, to get over, to get across; to pass on (to), to proceed (to), to turn (to); to change, to switch (from/to), to convert (to); to turn (into), to change, to convert, to transform (to), to go (into). Wiktionary: пере- + ходи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **переживём** — пережи́ть (perfective): (transitive) to survive; (by extension, transitive) to ride out, to go/get/live through; to be through, to get over (a hardship); to outlive. Wiktionary: пере- + жить.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: перевести́ — to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch; переходи́ть — to cross, to get over, to get across; перенести́ — to transfer, to carry, to transport; пережи́ть — (transitive) to survive.

**переношу** — переноси́ть (imperfective): to transfer, to carry, to transport (somewhere); to carry over (a word) to the next line; to postpone, to put off; to extend (to). Wiktionary: пере- + носи́ть.
